title: Marvel's Spider-Man Eternal: card flavor text

entities.name: Spider-Man
entities.description: A hero who believes that heroes save people.

entities.name: MJ
entities.description: A rising star who speaks as the host of the show Secret Hospital.

entities.name: Secret Hospital
entities.description: A show whose season finale MJ promotes.

entities.name: Alchemax
entities.description: A company that likes its Slayer-Bots to have no qualms about collateral damage.

entities.name: Lyla
entities.description: A 22nd century holographic assistant, a Lyrate Life-form Approximation, who anticipates what is needed.

entities.name: Spider-Man 2099
entities.description: A Spider-Man from the future who asks Lyla whether they have arrived in the Heroic Age.

entities.name: Heroic Age
entities.description: An era Spider-Man 2099 hopes to reach.

entities.name: Grendel
entities.description: An ancient terror from beyond the stars that awakens to ravage the world.

entities.name: Venom
entities.description: Eddie Brock, whose prayers for vengeance were answered by a darkness from another world; his favorite crime was punishment.

entities.name: Life Foundation
entities.description: An organization that captured Venom and extracted seeds for newborn symbiotes.

entities.name: Symbiotes
entities.description: Newborn creatures grown from seeds extracted from Venom, which the Life Foundation could not control.

entities.name: Ghost-Spider
entities.description: A hero who teams up with Spider-Man and is often late for practice.

entities.name: The Mary Janes
entities.description: A band that performs the song "Face It Tiger."

entities.name: Face It Tiger
entities.description: A song by The Mary Janes.

entities.name: Lizard Peter Parker
entities.description: The Earth-65 version of Peter Parker, Gwen's classmate turned Lizard, who wanted to be special.

entities.name: Earth-65
entities.description: The world of Gwen Stacy and this version of Peter Parker.

entities.name: Prowler
entities.description: A misguided mentor to Miles who made his own choices, good and bad.

entities.name: Miles Morales
entities.description: A young hero who stores bio-electricity and unleashes it in a Venom Blast.

events.summary: Spider-Man 2099 asks Lyla whether their attempt worked and whether they have arrived in the Heroic Age.
events.quote: "Lyla, did it work? Are we in the Heroic Age?"

events.summary: Grendel, an ancient terror from beyond the stars, awakens to ravage the world.
events.quote: An ancient terror from beyond the stars now awakens to ravage the world.

events.summary: The Life Foundation captures Venom and extracts seeds for newborn symbiotes it cannot control.
events.quote: The Life Foundation captured Venom and extracted seeds for newborn symbiotes.

events.summary: Eddie Brock's prayers for vengeance are answered by a darkness from another world, making him Venom.
events.quote: Eddie Brock's prayers for vengeance were answered by a darkness from another world.

events.summary: Ghost-Spider teams up with Spider-Man, urging him to keep up.
events.quote: "Keep up, Spider-Man. We don't have all night!"

events.summary: Ghost-Spider stops a runaway bus despite being late for practice.
events.quote: I'm late for practice again, but sure, I have time for a runaway bus.

events.summary: Peter Parker of Earth-65, as the Lizard, confesses to Gwen he just wanted to be special like her.
events.quote: "I just . . . just . . . wanted to be special . . . like you, Gwen."

events.summary: Prowler tells Miles he must make his own choices.
events.quote: "I made my choices, Miles, good and bad. Now you need to make yours."

events.summary: Miles releases his anger, frustration and stored bio-electricity.
events.quote: Miles released his anger, his frustration, and his stored up bio-electricity.
